$ permissions mode ask
Updated permissions

$ permissions allow Bash:go test*
Updated permissions

$ permissions deny Write:secret.txt
Updated permissions

$ permissions list
{
  "allow": [
    "Bash:go test*"
  ],
  "deny": [
    "Write:secret.txt"
  ],
  "defaultMode": "ask"
}

$ permissions remove Write:secret.txt
Updated permissions

$ permissions clear
Updated permissions

$ permissions list
{
  "defaultMode": "ask"
}
